newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit Bank lower on media reports.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit Bank lower on media reports.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank was battered lower on Thursday, despite its denials of media reports on Wednesday that said its business could be affected by loan guarantees it made to a financially troubled non-bank unit, brokers said.
As of 0146 GMT, the shares were down 19 yen at 310 yen, making them the third-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

A bank spokesman said on Wednesday that while the bank had given a written statement to the institutions, this meant the bank would continue to support the restructuring of the non-bank affiliate, Crown Leasing Corp.
"It did not mean guarantees on the loans," he said.
